findings.description: The first no-decision settlement gate required an unprepared settlement, preventing a valid expired unresolved full-refund plan from being processed after preparation set preparedAt.
findings.resolution: The gate now permits only an already-locked EXPIRED/FUNDING_FAILED full-refund snapshot with matching V3 asset/received/reason, zero payout, no published decision reference and no PAYOUT operations, after the original expiry. It does not create payout authority. The current election finance suite executes unresolved-expiry preparation, processing and replay with both target outcomes, including an original contributor after leaving.

findings.description: The initial membership/power guards compared timestamptz clock_timestamp() against UTC-naive Prisma TIMESTAMP values, allowing a non-UTC PostgreSQL session timezone to shift the eligibility cutoff.
findings.resolution: The additive migration explicitly normalizes database clock comparisons and trigger-created timestamps to UTC. The current integration fixture changes session TimeZone to Asia/Dhaka while exercising pre-cutoff membership tracking. The mixed-type comparison semantics were independently confirmed against PostgreSQL primary documentation; historical timestamp columns and data were not rewritten.

findings.description: The initial selection-closed audit event could record TIED or a sole winner while the persisted non-winner-all result was ALLOCATION_SELECTED with no sole winner.
findings.resolution: The audit now records the same allocation-selected outcome and null sole-winner identity that are persisted for V3 proportional/ranked decisions. The revised source was inspected and current round/election regressions pass.

findings.description: An early integration trigger read operation-only fields on ledger transaction records, which could reject otherwise valid payout execution.
findings.resolution: The additive replacement separates RoundOperation intent validation from RoundLedgerTransaction execution-key/source/destination validation. Current end-to-end payouts across all six mode/policy combinations execute through these guards; early-veto SQL bypass attempts still fail.

observations: Historical failed checks remain in the evidence history. The repaired test fixtures preserve product restrictions: the veto-expiry case respects the minimum expiry interval, and the UNKNOWN case explicitly rejects a noncontributor before running concurrent authorized workers. Product authorization was not relaxed to force a passing test.

All financial observations in this part are local simulation. Local ledger absence is not represented as proof of external non-submission, inclusion or finality. Real verified NEAR testnet deposits, payouts and refunds remain mandatory Part 5 work.

Database/browser execution evidence is from the independently hash-verified coordinator-run workflow receipts and logs. The reviewer additionally ran the pure allocation checks directly and inspected source, tests and rendered artifacts without changing product data.
